content:
Lina (CS): quick sync on Arborix renewal 126. procurement sent unsigned PO; they want card instead of wire. missing: signed PO pdf, VAT cert, exact legal name and billing email. tagging @Omar @Diane
Omar (Sales): buyer ok with card if we show invoice sample with VAT line and company name. they provided provisional vendor id ARB-EU-99 but finance flagged mismatch.
Diane (Legal): for DE entities we require signed PO or delegated signer letter. can allow one-time card charge if buyer signs 1-paragraph addendum committing to provide signed PO + VAT cert within 14 days. i'll draft.
Kai (Ops): ops needs legal name (no abbreviations), billing email, and SOW before full provisioning. provisional vendor id ok for temporary charge.
Lina (CS): PO snippet from buyer DM:
```
PO#: A-2026-33 (unsigned)
Bill To: Arborix GmbH
Seats: 80
Term: 12mo
Total: EUR 24,000
Billing: acctspay@arborix.de
Vendor ID: ARB-EU-99 (provisional)
```
Lina (CS): buyer claims reverse charge. asked them to upload VAT cert + company extract.
billing-bot: draft INV-3247 created (EUR 24,000)  status: draft, missing SOW.
Omar (Sales): propose card tokenization for month1 only. conditions: 1) addendum signed 2) PO + VAT cert in 14 days 3) card covers month1 non-refundable. legal ok?
Diane (Legal): ok, addendum will say: "Buyer to deliver signed PO and VAT certificate within 14 calendar days; failure allows Seller to withhold provisioning."
Kai (Ops): ops will provision seats on successful card charge but mark onboarding as pending compliance until docs arrive. won't enable prod access until SOW attached.
Lina (CS): action items: Lina request VAT cert + signed PO + company extract. Omar escalate if docs delayed. Diane to drop addendum. Kai prepare provisioning flag.
Omar (Sales): pinged finance lead. they said legal sign-off may take up to 10 business days.
Lina (CS): customer-facing message sent offering card + addendum. buyer asked if company extract + CEO email is enough as interim.
Diane (Legal): company extract + CEO email ok as intent confirmation but not a substitute for signed PO or delegation.
billing-bot: scheduled: if no signed PO by 2026-07-05T09:00Z, create PRO-3247 and attempt card capture at 09:15Z.
Kai (Ops): checklist: [ ] signed PO (pdf) [ ] VAT cert (pdf) [ ] SOW (pdf) [ ] billing contact confirmed.
Lina (CS): timeline: if addendum + VAT cert by Tue EOD, card charge Wed AM; otherwise escalate. will post addendum when Diane drops it. :thumbsup:
